name: randsample
expr: y = randsample(10, 3); n1 = double(numel(y)); w = randsample([10 20 30], 4, true, [0 0 1]); wc = randsample([10;20;30], 2, true, [0 1 0]); n2 = double(numel(randsample([10 20 30], 2)));
comment: Sig y=randsample(n,k) / y=randsample(pop,k[,replace,weights]). Population-vector form samples the vector's values along its length. Weights with all mass on one element are deterministic: randsample([10 20 30],4,true,[0 0 1]) = [30 30 30 30]; column population -> column output. numkit previously routed the population vector to datasample(dim=1) -> a row-vector population collapsed to N=1 and the weighted form ERRORED (weights length != sample-axis) -- fixed. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
